issues.title: Actual public acquisition time versus frozen supervisor-cycle time
issues.original_defect: Sequential REST records were persisted at actual receipts while same-cycle indexing used the earlier frozen cycle start. Ingestion was not represented as a later availability boundary, and receipt times could differ within the sequential response set.

pre_fix_reproduction.fixture: Temporary advancing deterministic clock with distinct request and response receipts; asserted all records become available only after the last actual receipt.
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: The earliest record availability was 1800000100000000 ns while the latest response receipt was 1800001400000000 ns; the post-acquisition-boundary assertion failed.

issues.root_cause: A fixed cycle cutoff and a sequential acquisition completion boundary had been treated as though they were the same timestamp.
issues.fix: Preserve actual HTTP receipts; set ingestion/availability no earlier than the completed acquisition boundary; keep the original supervisor cutoff and immutable event cutoff/deadline; defer post-start evidence until the next eligible cycle; surface elapsed events only as their exact expired events.
issues.remaining_status: TESTED; genuinely slow/live acquisition remains UNVERIFIED / TEST GATE.

issues.title: Recovery must not infer complete trade history from contiguous bars
issues.original_defect: The recovery predicate used archived bar continuity as proof that a disconnect gap was repaired, although REST only exposes a bounded latest-100-trade page without a cursor or historical backfill.

pre_fix_reproduction.fixture: Temporary baseline check invoked the original recovery predicate on a fresh contiguous-bar snapshot and required trade completeness to remain unproven.
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: The original bar-overlap predicate returned true and could authorize aggregate source recovery without trade-continuity evidence.

issues.root_cause: Bar continuity and trade-history continuity were combined into one aggregate recovery claim.
issues.fix: Persist separate endpoint reachability, bar coverage/gap, observed-trade, trade-continuity and S3-coverage fields. After an unhealthy transition, bounded REST cannot prove the missing trade history, so recovery remains fail-closed and S3 remains TEST GATE / NOT ESTIMABLE.
issues.remaining_status: TEST GATE; a separate qualified trade-continuity capability or versioned change is required before recovery can assert completeness. No WebSocket or historical backfill was added.

issues.title: Decision-calendar origins must follow the persisted source trigger
issues.original_defect: The calendar compared expected M15 close origins to event information cutoffs, so a handoff received two seconds after bar close could be recorded as missing and instrument identity could be collapsed.

pre_fix_reproduction.observed: The baseline reported no observed M15 handoff although the persisted final bar closed at the expected origin and its receipt/cutoff was T + 2 seconds.

issues.root_cause: Expected origins and observed events were keyed by different timestamps, and the old accounting key was not a full instrument identity.
issues.fix: Resolve the immutable event through exact trigger, observation, confirmed bar and product references; match on bar close, full instrument key and revision; report information cutoff, receipt, availability, processing, deadline and missing/ineligible evidence separately. Keep native S3 M1 slots separate.
issues.remaining_status: TESTED; absent slots are not labeled absent opportunities.

issues.title: Science artifact inventory and unsupported stores
issues.original_defect: Displayed science counts included classes outside the retrieved type set, causing real persisted M0 evidence to appear as zero; research calibration had no supported artifact-index query.

pre_fix_reproduction.observed: A qualifying as-of M0 calibration was reported as count zero instead of one.

issues.root_cause: The report's displayed science type set and its artifact query contract did not match.
issues.fix: Inventory exact persisted M0, M1, analogue, pretrade, execution, cost and Discovery Lab artifact types; validate typed payload versions, exact fields and hashes; filter by available_at_ns before paging. Unsupported research calibration is unavailable with an explanation, not zero. Malformed index rows gate science counts to null.
issues.remaining_status: TESTED; an unavailable producer/store remains explicitly UNAVAILABLE.

issues.title: Complete bounded artifact inventory above 10000 rows
issues.original_defect: A single capped mixed query could truncate a large campaign inventory, leaving partial denominators despite reporting truncation.

pre_fix_reproduction.observed: The baseline repository had no read_snapshot API and could not provide one consistent bounded multi-page read.

issues.root_cause: The report did not have stable cursor pagination across a consistent read transaction.
issues.fix: Use read-only SQLite snapshot transactions and keyset order (created_at_ns DESC, artifact_ref DESC), applying the as-of filter in SQL. Page and record work are bounded; detail retention and chronology samples are capped; interrupted or invalid inventories are explicit, and incomplete aggregate counts become null.
issues.remaining_status: TESTED; histories beyond configured page/work limits report TEST GATE rather than a complete denominator.

issues.title: S3 readiness must prove persisted causal lineage
issues.original_defect: A large synthetic residual array and placeholder VWAP references tested numerical readiness but did not prove that production preflight validated persisted causal artifacts.

pre_fix_reproduction.observed: The baseline report did not produce the persisted per-instrument evidence view required to distinguish lineage from array counts.

issues.root_cause: The pure numerical evaluator's inputs were being treated as sufficient production evidence without a separate persisted-reference validation layer.
issues.fix: Validate exact M1 bars, trade identities, persisted VWAP inputs and source-health refs, residual-to-bar/VWAP links, timestamps, cutoff availability, 10081-bar coverage, 120 strictly preceding residuals, event gate and fresh BBO. The evaluator's arrays are only mathematical sufficiency; REST trade continuity remains unproven.
issues.remaining_status: TEST GATE / NOT ESTIMABLE for deployed S3 qualification; policy and native M1 cadence are unchanged.

issues.title: Whole-cycle public request and event-freshness budget
issues.original_defect: Individual HTTP timeouts did not bound total sequential acquisition time; the 13 market-data calls could outlast the frozen five-second final-M15 event freshness window.

pre_fix_reproduction.observed: The original snapshot had no request-count or whole-acquisition-duration accounting; the bounded-deadline assertion could not pass.

issues.root_cause: Per-request timeouts were not composed under one monotonic collection deadline.

request_budget.profile: one server-time, eight kline, two ticker and two recent-trade requests, sequentially
request_budget.optional_metadata_bootstrap: One separate bounded product-info request during startup or metadata refresh; included in the same five-second monotonic collection budget.
request_budget.physical_http_call_bound: At most 14 when metadata bootstrap is required; otherwise 13.

issues.remaining_status: TEST GATE; live public throughput and owner-host latency remain UNVERIFIED. Existing event windows were not enlarged.
